title: Add webapp template: tailwind.config.js
description: Create the Tailwind CSS v4 configuration for the client template. Content paths should target all TypeScript/TSX files in src/. Include shadcn/ui CSS variable theme setup.
acceptanceCriteria: CSS variable theme configuration is included
Template file exists with content paths and CSS variable theme

steps.details: Create src/templates/webapp/client/tailwind.config.js: /** @type {import('tailwindcss').Config} */ export default { content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme: { extend: { colors: { background: 'hsl(var(--background))', foreground: 'hsl(var(--foreground))', primary: { DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--primary))', foreground: 'hsl(var(--primary-foreground))' } } } }, plugins: [] }

steps.description: Add CSS variable definitions to index.css
steps.details: Update src/templates/webapp/client/src/index.css (from TASK-25) to include the base CSS variable definitions: :root { --background: 0 0% 100%; --foreground: 222.2 84% 4.9%; --primary: 222.2 47.4% 11.2%; --primary-foreground: 210 40% 98%; } .dark { --background: 222.2 84% 4.9%; --foreground: 210 40% 98%; }

technicalNotes: Tailwind v4 may use a different config format — check the Tailwind v4 migration guide if the config format changes
CSS variables enable shadcn/ui components to work with both light and dark themes
